mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, post_id, comment_id, message) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{postId}, #{commentId}, #{message})

INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, post_id, message, like_dedup_key) VALUES (#{userId}, 'LIKE', #{postId}, #{message}, CONCAT(#{postId}, '_', #{userId})) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM post_likes WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND type = 'LIKE' AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
SELECT id AS notification_id, type, post_id, comment_id, message, is_read, created_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE, like_dedup_key = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
